title: Slow-cooker Creamy Overnight Porridge
steps: Spray the slow-cooker bowl with cooking spray.
Add oats, milk, water and a pinch of salt. Stir, lid on, dial to low.
Remove lid, stir well to break up crusty edges, and serve with your favourite toppings.
notes: If too thick, loosen with a splash of milk. Leftovers keep in fridge; reheat in microwave. Toppings not included in calorie count.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
